open_points.subject: listener cleanup diagnostics
open_points.text: “a close that fails is named in a diagnostic of its own” contradicts “A stopped start: one diagnostic naming the first failed item”
open_points.question: When opening a listener fails and closing an already-open listener also fails, does the stopped start produce only the original listener diagnostic or both diagnostics?
options: Produce the listener-open diagnostic and a separate listener-close diagnostic.
Produce only the listener-open diagnostic naming the first failure.
Replace the listener-open diagnostic with the listener-close diagnostic.
open_points.default_guess: Produce both diagnostics, in event order: listener-open failure first and listener-close failure second.

witness.initial: A non-owner-only start has passed configuration, backup and store checks; the owner-interface listener can open, the service-API listener cannot open, and closing the owner-interface listener reports failure.
events: module:instance_lifecycle attempts to open the service-API listener and that operation fails.
module:instance_lifecycle attempts to close the owner-interface listener and that close reports failure.
The Registry process ends and releases the listener.
outcomes: Step 4 yields the service-API listener diagnostic plus a diagnostic of the close failure.
The Outcomes section yields one diagnostic naming only the first failed item, the service API listener.
witness.observer: The host administrator reading the startup diagnostics.
